parties.petitioner: Bhudev Mallick Alias Bhudeb Mallick & Anr.

summary: Execution of 40-year-old decree; maintainability of belated execution; written objections rejected by Executing Court; High Court rejected CO challenging rejection of objections; decree for declaration of title and permanent injunction dated 1976; appellants claim continuous possession since 1980; decree holders' execution application alleging breach of injunction; objections on grounds of illegibility, lack of possession by decree holders, limitation; Executing Court declined objections; High Court upheld rejection; Supreme Court allowed exemption application and leave to appeal.
final_judgment: Exemption Application allowed; leave granted; appeal admitted for hearing.
